en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a grand historicist building with domes and elaborate façades on a corner square with tree‑lined streets and people walking. The lower margin identifies the scene as Graz, Bismarckplatz, Café Kaiserhof. On the right is a printed advertisement in German for the firm Vinzenz Oblack in Graz, and along the left edge is a vertical publishing credit.
